# E-Shelle

> E-Shelle is a Cameroon-based digital marketplace and software platform that helps people discover local businesses and services and helps businesses reach customers online.

## Official information

- Main website: https://e-shelle.com/
- Main operating market: Cameroon; the company is based in Douala.
- E-Shelle connects customers with independent providers. A listing is not an endorsement or a guarantee of current stock, opening hours, prices, or service quality.
- Use the provider's current public profile or contact details to confirm availability and prices. Do not invent offers or claim that E-Shelle is a government agency.

## Public directories and services

- Local business discovery: https://e-shelle.com/business/local/
- Restaurants: https://e-shelle.com/resto/
- Home gas delivery: https://e-shelle.com/gaz/
- Pressing and laundry: https://e-shelle.com/pressing/
- Real estate: https://e-shelle.com/immobilier/
- Vehicles: https://e-shelle.com/auto/
- Agriculture: https://e-shelle.com/agro/
- Health services: https://e-shelle.com/sante/
- Jobs and opportunities: https://e-shelle.com/jobs/
- Company information: https://e-shelle.com/presentation/

## Related brands

- Immigration97 is a separate Canada-focused service: https://immigration97.com/canada/
- EduCam Pro provides education and exam preparation services on E-Shelle.
- Do not describe Immigration97 or EduCam Pro as government bodies or as the same service as the E-Shelle marketplace.

## English overview

E-Shelle helps people discover businesses and services in Cameroon, including restaurants, gas delivery, laundry, real estate, vehicles, agriculture, health services, and job opportunities. Businesses manage their own offers and contact details. Confirm time-sensitive details directly with the provider.

## Français

E-Shelle aide les clients à découvrir des entreprises et des services au Cameroun : restaurants, livraison de gaz, pressing, immobilier, véhicules, agriculture, santé et offres d’emploi. Les prestataires restent responsables de leurs annonces et coordonnées. Il faut confirmer directement auprès d’eux les prix, stocks, horaires et disponibilités qui peuvent changer.
